attributes.action: Notification for ULEZ charges SHOULD BE required before issueing fines.
attributes.additional_details:
If I drive into a ULEZ zone with the belief that my vehicle isn't affected by the charge, but I am never notified of otherwise, does this really incur that I am to be blamed for 'avoiding a charge'  or that I am blindly 'refusing' to pay? - It is more likely that we were just unaware!

Are we living beneath a government; or a Mafia state? - Who demand you pay a fine (you weren't even aware of) or you must pay more!

It is a scam there are no notifications, an obvious money making scheme!
attributes.background: The government should implement upon TFL that there should be some form of notification of ULEZ charges to vehicle owners before dealing out ridiculous unaffordable fines.

rejection.details:
This is formally a matter for the Mayor of London and the London Assembly who have responsibility for TfL and ULEZ charges, nor for the UK Government or for Parliament.

You may wish to petition the London Assembly about this:

https://www.london.gov.uk/who-we-are/what-london-assembly-does/london-assembly-petitions
